log.adif-exported-with-lotw: ADIF exported (with LoTW / eQSL status). Sign in at LoTW (TQSL) or eQSL to upload this file, then tick the matching status back in the log.
log.dxcc-waz-all-cq: DXCC · WAZ all CQ zones · WAS all US states · IOTA islands on the air
log.dxcc-most-wanted-list: DXCC most-wanted list · chasing rare entities
log.lotw-confirmations-eqsl-qrz: LoTW confirmations · eQSL · QRZ · Club Log
log.delete-card-image-confirm: Delete the card image for this QSO?
log.card-image-unsupported: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP images are supported
log.card-image-too-large: Image too large (12 MB / 50 MP limit)
log.card-image-save-failed: Could not save: local storage is unavailable
log.card-image-delete-failed: Could not delete: local storage is unavailable
log.save-this-qso-then: Save this QSO, then upload a scan.
log.pick-a-template-then: Pick a template, then pull a QSO in from the log
log.print-at-140: Prints as a standard 140 × 89 mm card — choose Save as PDF in the print dialog to export a PDF.
log.world-map-scroll-to: World map (scroll to zoom, drag to pan, pinch to zoom, double-click to reset, antimeridian wrap)
log.the-standard-plain-text: The standard plain-text format for contest log submission.
log.great-circle-paths-from: Great-circle paths from your station to each worked grid
log.wrapped-in-start-of: Wrapped in START-OF-LOG / END-OF-LOG, with station and contest information.
log.keep-the-original-log: Keep the original log for appeals or verifying contacts.
log.qsos-with-the-same: QSOs with the same callsign are merged onto one label; stick it on the back of a QSL card to send
log.mark-these-qsos-as-uploaded: Mark these {} QSOs as uploaded to LoTW? Do this only after LoTW confirms the upload.
log.marked-as-uploaded-lotw: Marked {} QSOs as uploaded to LoTW. When the LoTW report arrives, bring the confirmations back with Sync QSL.
log.no-report-yet-sign: No report yet? Sign and upload with TQSL first, then download it from LoTW.
log.qsl-source-channels: Este informe solo habla de {}; los campos de otros canales se ignoran.
log.qsl-source-analysis-only: Este origen no tiene canal al que escribir: las confirmaciones de QRZ comparten el campo genérico QSL_RCVD con las tarjetas de papel y no adivinamos cuál es, así que el informe solo se usa para el emparejamiento.
log.diff-summary: Filas {} · emparejadas {} · por revisar {} · ausentes en local {}
log.diff-conflict-hint: Un conflicto significa que el registro local dice confirmado pero el informe no. El informe puede ser parcial (por ejemplo, un solo rango de fechas) y «Preferir informe» borra la confirmación local, así que revisa cada fila.
log.diff-missing-hint: Estas filas del informe no tienen QSO correspondiente en local:
log.submit-your-log-before: Submit your log before the deadline on the contest website.
log.log-online-saved-locally: Log online · saved locally · export ADIF / CSV
log.the-live-list-is: The live list is unavailable; the built-in reference list below is sorted by rarity.
log.all-sent-qsls-are: All sent QSLs are confirmed — excellent!
log.worked-grid-map-scroll: Worked-grid map (scroll to zoom, drag to pan, pinch to zoom, double-click to reset, antimeridian wrap)
log.when-printing-choose-actual: When printing choose Actual size / 100% and turn off headers and footers, otherwise the labels will be misaligned.

log.mark-these-qsos-as.one: Mark this {} QSO as QSL sent?
log.mark-these-qsos-as.other: Mark these {} QSOs as QSL sent?

log.counts-qsos-multipliers-zone: Counts QSOs, multipliers (zone / prefix / state) and the total score per the rules.
log.before-submitting-check-callsigns: Before submitting, check callsigns, exchanges and times; format errors get rejected.
log.search-callsign-name-qth: Search callsign / name / QTH / grid / notes
log.data-from-club-log: Data from Club Log; numbers are ADIF DXCC entity codes (see the DXCC entity table).

log.qsos-tagged-with-this.one: QSO tagged with this contest in the log: {}
log.qsos-tagged-with-this.other: QSOs tagged with this contest in the log: {}

log.no-qsos-in-the: No QSOs in the log yet.
log.no-recognized-entities-yet: No recognized entities yet; they appear once you add QSOs.
log.no-grids-yet-they: No grids yet; they appear once you add QSOs with a grid.
log.no-records-yet-add: No records yet — add your first QSO.
log.no-qsos-yet-add: No QSOs yet — add records in QSO log first, or import from ADIF / CSV.
log.more-fields-power-end: More fields: power, end time, satellite / propagation, SOTA / POTA, CQ / ITU zones
log.records-without-a-cq: Records without a CQ / ITU zone are estimated from the DXCC entity's main zone; for countries spanning several zones (e.g. USA, Russia, China) this may be inaccurate — fill it in under More fields. VUCC counts 4-character grids on 6m and above. Official applications follow ARRL / CQ confirmation rules.
log.no-grid-given-estimated: No grid given; estimated from the DXCC entity center
log.station-info-is-written: Station info is written into the STATION_CALLSIGN / OPERATOR / MY_GRIDSQUARE / MY_RIG / MY_ANTENNA fields of every ADIF record.
log.lookup-failed-or-no: Lookup failed or no data for this callsign
log.each-record-frequency-mode: Each record: frequency, mode, date, time, their callsign, exchange.
log.no-qsos-waiting-to: No QSOs waiting to be sent. Switch to All to print again.
log.scroll-pinch-to-zoom: Scroll/pinch to zoom · drag to pan · double-click to reset · type a grid to locate · click a field/square to expand
log.export-cabrillo-automatically-with: Export Cabrillo automatically with logging software (N1MM, DXLog, etc.) to avoid manual errors.
log.partly-used-sheet-skip: Partly used sheet: skip the labels already removed

log.clear-all-qso-records.one: Clear all {} QSO record? Export an ADIF backup first. This cannot be undone.
log.clear-all-qso-records.other: Clear all {} QSO records? Export an ADIF backup first. This cannot be undone.

log.paste-an-adif-confirmation: Paste a confirmation report (ADIF) from LoTW / eQSL / Club Log, review the diff and decide row by row; nothing changes until you apply it.
log.cannot-resolve-this-point: Cannot resolve this point to a grid
log.paste-or-upload-a: Paste or upload a confirmation report (ADIF) first.
log.reads-records-in-the: Reads records in the QSO log carrying the matching CONTEST_ID (with exchange and claimed score). During a contest we recommend using
log.closer-to-the-goal: Closer to the goal first — prioritize these
log.station-callsign-not-set: Station callsign not set — From won't appear on the labels. Go to
log.dupe-already-worked-on: Dupe: already worked on the same band and mode
log.set-your-grid-in: Set your grid in station info first
log.automatic-serials-live-dupe: : automatic serials, live dupe checking, one-click export afterwards.
log.diff-report-empty: No QSOs were parsed from the report — check the file format
log.diff-report-truncated: The report looks truncated, so some QSOs may be missing. Export it again and retry.
